mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dms_message_delivery_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,tenant_id,task_id,attempt_no,state,provider_code,query_count,estimated_cost,actual_cost,error_code,submitted_time,resolved_time,create_time,update_time FROM dms_message_delivery_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_message_delivery_attempt SET state=#{state},provider_message_id=#{providerMessageId},actual_cost=COALESCE(#{actualCost},0),error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},resolved_time=#{resolvedTime},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE dms_message_delivery_attempt SET query_count=query_count+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
